[Everyone Wants a Child Like Eileen Gu](https://violetagordeljevic.substack.com/p/everyone-wants-a-child-like-eileen),
by Violeta Gordeljevic on Substack, 4 September 2026.

**Children like Eileen Gu come out of demanding childhoods, and the parenting
behind them combines warmth with high expectations.** Gu is the Olympic
freestyle skier who also scored 1580 on the SAT and studied at Stanford.
Gordeljevic sets her against current advice that favours unstructured play,
and points to Djokovic, Polgár and Yo-Yo Ma as further cases of sustained
parental expectation and practice.

- **Passion follows competence.** Gordeljevic argues that "passion doesn't
  usually come first": a child comes to love an activity after exposure and
  practice have made them good at it.
- **Authoritative parenting.** The term from developmental psychology for
  warmth together with high expectations, as distinct from a permissive style
  that asks little of the child. In her words, "The choice was never between
  pressure and love. It was always meant to be both."
